author: Liqvera repository security audit
tooling: Trivy 0.74.0 and Grype 0.120.1; exact image and BusyBox binary hash verification against reviewed security backports

statements.impact_statement: The advisory concerns Ada.cx Sentry configuration. Installed ada-libs is the unrelated ada-url C++ URL parser. Grype matched an ambiguous product name.

statements.action_statement: Upstream-reviewed BusyBox URL guard applied to pinned Alpine recipe. The exact gateway and web binaries match the reviewed patched SHA-256 4261945c0287000d3e73548d381a5afa4279eb07ed6e223ee6c5c51ba39f1642. Eight security regressions passed in the prior backport audit; 304 applets retained and corresponding source included in each image.
